name: 나무뿌리 동굴
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: No people, no text, no UI, cinematic child-friendly cave interior with massive tangled tree roots forming a natural ceiling lattice, small glowing mushrooms sprouting from every crevice; symmetrical wide composition, open lower-central foreground, warm amber mushroom glow contrasted with cool teal light seeping through root gaps, earthy soil texture, layered subterranean depth, mysterious fantasy concept art, faint dust motes suspended in the glow.
